OVERVIEW

The Elder Scrolls Online: Tamriel Unlimited v2.0.5 is an incremental patch that fixes issues surrounding gameplay, a few quests, and the boss encounter in Veteran Fungal Grotto, among other items.

FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS

Alliance War

General

  • Firepot trebuchet weapons now have a delay between impact and their first damage-over-time tick.

Combat & Gameplay

General

  • Enemies hit by knockbacks will now take proper fall damage.
  • Fixed an issue where you could not view any effects. Note that this would only affect what you saw, and not what others could see.
  • Costumes will no longer be applied while in Werewolf form.
  • Fixed an issue where you would appear to be partially underground while riding your mount.
  • Fixed an issue that was causing you to be unable to dismount.

Templar

Dawn’s Wrath

  • Radiant Destruction: This ability now cancels if the enemy moves out of your line of sight.

Weapon

Destruction Staff

  • Elemental Drain: Fixed an issue where multiple ranks of this ability could stack their magicka restore.

Alliance War

Support

  • Cleanse: Fixed an issue where this ability wasn’t increasing magicka reneration from the Support passive Magicka Aid.

  • Known Issue: Cleanse does not currently work properly specifically for Rank I, and will be fixed in a future patch.

Crown Store

General

  • The Bantam Guar’s default name no longer violates naming conventions. Crown Repair Kits can no longer be used while in combat.

Dungeons & Group Content

Veteran Dungeons

  • Fixed multiple issues with the Spawn of Mephala encounter within Veteran Fungal Grotto:

  • The two Watcher beams will no longer occasionally fire at the same time. Visual telegraphs for the Watcher's Daedric Burn and Daedric Destruction abilities now appear correctly, and the damage from these abilities is consistent with the telegraph location.

  • The beam from Daedric Burn will now correctly appear each time the ability is cast. The spiders inside the portal will now wait for you to engage before attacking, and will now consistently spawn and not get stuck inside the environment.

  • The Spawn of Mephala's Daedric Explosion ability will now correctly display the telegraph and visual effects while casting.

  • The portals that pull you into the pocket realm will now continue to appear throughout the encounter, as intended.

  • The knock back and stun applied by Shadow Bolt is now CC-breakable, as intended. If you are knocked off the ledge and into the water, you’ll now have the correct knock down animation.

  • The Spawn of Mephala will now reset if pulled up the nearby ramp or pulled too close to the bridge.

Exploration & Itemization

Item Sets

  • Thunderous Plate Mail: Fixed an issue where some types of melee attacks had a 100% chance to proc this item set.

Quests & Zones

Shadowfen

  • Trials of the Burnished Scales: Fixed an issue where the Argonian warriors could occasionally not be dueled.

UI

General

  • Fixed an issue where hyperlinks on the login screen would bring up a blank window instead of taking you to the hyperlinked page.
